subject: Routeing Change - Howe Sound, Strait of Georgia, Vancouver Harbour
text:
Routeing Change - Howe Sound, Strait of Georgia, Vancouver Harbour
The West Vancouver Yacht Club Snowflake Race is taking place from 1655 to 2100 UTC  01 Nov 2026. 
The race will take place in Burrard Inlet and Queen Charlotte Channel. 
Participating vessels will be monitoring VHF channels 12 and 73.
